cases.question: What is our total revenue?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many customers are there?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_id) AS "customer_count"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
ORDER BY "customer_count" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many orders have been placed?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT il.invoice_id) AS "order_count"
FROM invoice_line il
ORDER BY "order_count" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many tracks were sold in total?
cases.sql:
SELECT SUM(il.quantity) AS "units_sold"
FROM invoice_line il
ORDER BY "units_sold" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: What is the average order value?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT il.invoice_id), 0), 2) AS "avg_order_value"
FROM invoice_line il
ORDER BY "avg_order_value" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Revenue by year
cases.sql:
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM i.invoice_date) AS INTEGER) AS "year", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "year" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show revenue by country
cases.sql:
SELECT i.billing_country AS "country", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Units sold by genre
cases.sql:
SELECT g.name AS "genre", SUM(il.quantity) AS "units_sold"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id
JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "units_sold" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Revenue per media type
cases.sql:
SELECT mt.name AS "media_type", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id
JOIN media_type mt ON mt.media_type_id = t.media_type_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Revenue by support rep
cases.sql:
SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS "support_rep", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Average order value by year

FROM invoice_line il

cases.question: Revenue and units sold per year
cases.sql:
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM i.invoice_date) AS INTEGER) AS "year", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue", SUM(il.quantity) AS "units_sold"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "year" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Revenue by year and media type
cases.sql:
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM i.invoice_date) AS INTEGER) AS "year", mt.name AS "media_type", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id
JOIN media_type mt ON mt.media_type_id = t.media_type_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY "year" ASC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Revenue from Rock tracks in 2024
cases.sql:
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM i.invoice_date) AS INTEGER) AS "year", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id
JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id
WHERE g.name = ? AND CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM i.invoice_date) AS INTEGER) = ?
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "year" ASC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Units sold in the United States in 2025
cases.sql:
SELECT strftime(i.invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS "month", i.billing_country AS "country", SUM(il.quantity) AS "units_sold"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id
WHERE strftime(i.invoice_date, '%Y-%m') IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) AND i.billing_country = ?
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY "units_sold" DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Top 10 artists by revenue
cases.sql:
SELECT ar.name AS "artist", ROUND(SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity), 2) AS "revenue"
FROM invoice_line il
JOIN track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id
JOIN album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id
JOIN artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC
LIMIT 10
